name: TDP Connector
description: Production TDP package backed by the existing TDP device tools. It syncs host assets, vulnerability findings, and alert/log investigation results.

release.notes: Adds read-only TDP asset, vulnerability, and alert sync through the device tool registry.
changelog: Uses TDP host asset, vulnerability, and log search tools.
Normalizes common TDP list/page response shapes into Flocks entities.
Keeps device targeting configurable through FLOCKS_CONNECTOR_DEVICE_ID.
